title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium on 1973-06-09
lineage: transferred by Matt Smith, remastered by Monte Barry (some flaws remain) MAC tapes > Nak BX300 > Apogee Mini Me > Mini DAC (monitoring/mastering) > Lynx  One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > 24/96 FLACs > Samplitude Pro > TLH > CD Tag
source: Source: taped by Monte Barry, Sony TC 2850SD portable stereo cassette recorder, Sony ECM 99 single-point stereo mic, mic is hand-held on mic-stand shaft, with arm raised up, FOB center infield, between sbd platform and stage platform;

ai_review.summary: Exceptional audience recording with crystal‑clear vintage sound; the concert shines on a sweet first set and a volcanic Sunshine Daydream.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the tape’s sonic quality, calling it possibly their favorite ever and noting its pristine, vintage character. Musically the show is described as incredibly sweet, with the first set deemed superior but the second still delivering highlights like China Doll and an explosive Sunshine Daydream, making for a high‑energy, memorable performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars and praise both the musical performance and the audio fidelity; with no criticisms, the combined show (70%) and recording (30%) scores merit a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised as a favorite tape with crystal‑clear vintage sound; no issues or dropouts mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set considered the stronger of the two, but the second set remains great with strong song choices and smooth transitions.
